about: Loaders sent to a Rockchip board in Maskrom mode before its flash is erased (irate_box/root/rkboard.py). The binaries are Rockchip's, under Rockchip's licence (LICENSES/LicenseRef-Rockchip-rkbin.txt): the official boot_merger outputs that Armbian hosts (armbian/rkbin, rk35/, PR #46), as Meshtastic's web flasher ships them.
